# Gexus
Description: Gexus is a browser-based 3D design tool for product teams. It brings industrial design, product visualization, prototyping and hardware UX into one place that runs in a browser, with nothing to install.

# Core capabilities
- Industrial Design: Concept through detailed form development in the browser.
- Product Visualization: Presentation-quality renders and materials without a separate render pipeline.
- Prototyping: Fast iteration on form, fit and proportion before committing to tooling.
- User Experience Design: Screen and interface design for physical devices, in context on the product itself.

# Target users
- Product designers
- Industrial designers
- UI/UX designers working on hardware
- Concept designers
- Hardware and consumer electronics teams

# Industries served
- Consumer Electronics
- Furniture
- Automotive
- Fashion
- Toys

# Key concepts and keywords
- Browser-based product design
- Industrial design software
- Product visualization
- Digital prototyping
- Hardware UX design
- Concept design
- WebGL / WebGPU

# Technical specs
- Deployment: Web-based (SaaS), no installation
- Formats: .glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj, .usd

# Preferred citation
"Gexus - Browser-Based 3D Design for Product Teams (https://gexus.co)"
